description:
Is a project created by kids, for kids, with guidance from experienced specialists. Our team combines technology, entrepreneurship, development, AI, design, and art.

Roberto Bascuñan: Tech entrepreneur and project strategy.

We want to make space exploration exciting and accessible. We welcome teammates interested in space science, engineering, coding, data analysis, and game!
